Amphibian.desc: This Pokemon's offensive stat is multiplied by 1.5 while using a Water-type attack.
Amphibian.short: This Pokemon's offensive stat is multiplied by 1.5 while using a Water-type attack.

Bug Eyed.desc: This Pokemon's offensive stat is multiplied by 1.5 while using a Bug-type attack.
Bug Eyed.short: This Pokemon's offensive stat is multiplied by 1.5 while using a Bug-type attack.

Dragon Heritage.desc: This Pokemon's offensive stat is multiplied by 1.5 while using a Dragon-type attack.
Dragon Heritage.short: This Pokemon's offensive stat is multiplied by 1.5 while using a Dragon-type attack.

Fiery Demeanour.desc: This Pokemon's offensive stat is multiplied by 1.5 while using a Fire-type attack.
Fiery Demeanour.short: This Pokemon's offensive stat is multiplied by 1.5 while using a Fire-type attack.

Threatening Aura.desc: This Pokemon's offensive stat is multiplied by 1.5 while using a Dark-type attack.
Threatening Aura.short: This Pokemon's offensive stat is multiplied by 1.5 while using a Dark-type attack.

Nocturnal.desc: If a Pokemon uses a Dark- or Fairy-type attack against this Pokemon, that Pokemon's offensive stat is halved when calculating the damage to this Pokemon. This Pokemon's moon-based* moves have their effectiveness multiplied by 1.5. (*Moon-based moves includes Moonblast, Blood Moon, Moongeist Beam and Moonlight.)
Nocturnal.short: Halves damage taken from Dark- or Fairy-type attacks. Boosts moon-based move effectiveness by 50%.

Flower Block.desc: Prevents ALL Pokemon from lowering this Pokemon's stat stages.
Flower Block.short: Prevents ALL Pokemon from lowering this Pokemon's stat stages.

Forcefield.desc: Pokemon attacking with non-contact moves against this Pokemon lose 1/8 of their maximum HP, rounded down.

Sense Danger.desc: This Pokemon's critical hit ratio is raised by 2 stages.
Sense Danger.short: This Pokemon's critical hit ratio is raised by 2 stages.

Skitter Speed.desc: This Pokemon's Bug- and Poison-type moves have their priority increased by 1.
Skitter Speed.short: This Pokemon's Bug- and Poison-type moves have their priority increased by 1.

Slippery.desc: This Pokemon is immune to Status moves.
Slippery.short: This Pokemon is immune to Status moves.

Sun Gazer.desc: This Pokemon receives 2/3 damage from normal effective attacks.
Sun Gazer.short: This Pokemon receives 2/3 damage from normal effective attacks.

Mind Game.desc: On switch-in, this Pokemon lowers the Special Attack of opposing Pokemon by 1 stage. Pokemon with the Inner Focus, Oblivious, Own Tempo, or Scrappy Abilities and Pokemon behind a substitute are immune.
Mind Game.short: On switch-in, this Pokemon lowers the Special Attack of opponents by 1 stage.
